title: Python REST APIs With Flask, Connexion, and SQLAlchemy – Part 1
description: Build a Flask REST API with Connexion and Swagger UI in this three-part series. Part one lays the foundation of your application.
summary: Most modern web applications are powered by a REST API under the hood. That way, developers can separate the front-end code from the back-end logic, and users can interact with the interface dynamically.
takeaways: If you want to refresh your knowledge on working with APIs, then you can give Python and REST APIs: Interacting With Web Services a read.
